faq.question: Which Fatima College is this?
faq.answer: This is Fatima College at Mary Land, Madurai 625018, affiliated to Madurai Kamaraj University. Annai Fathima College at Thirumangalam and similarly named colleges in other cities have separate identities and admissions.

faq.question: Who can apply to these routes?
faq.answer: These are verified regular academic routes for women meeting the programme-specific requirements. Foreign/NRI, transfer and lateral-entry availability needs a separate check; it is not established by these entries.

faq.question: Which programmes are covered?
faq.answer: The entries cover23 undergraduate and15 postgraduate academic routes. Aided and self-financed choices are separate. Professional, research, diploma and certificate admissions require their own checks.

faq.question: How long are these degrees?
faq.answer: The college’s current institutional submission identifies three-year undergraduate and two-year postgraduate programmes. Confirm the current curriculum and any separate external professional-study arrangements for the selected award.

faq.question: What subjects are needed for undergraduate admission?
faq.answer: Requirements differ by degree and stream. Science and commerce routes identify specific school subjects; some arts and design routes accept any +2 group. B.Com. Honours with ACCA has a separate 80% marks condition and named subjects.

faq.question: What is needed for postgraduate admission?
faq.answer: Each programme has a qualifying-degree route and 50% marks requirement. M.Sc. Data Science additionally requires Mathematics at +2 level. Check the exact list for the selected programme rather than assuming any degree is accepted.

faq.question: Is there a postgraduate entrance test?
faq.answer: The prospectus specifies an entrance test for M.A. Economics, M.A. English, M.A. Tamil, M.Sc. Physics and M.Com. Follow the college’s current test information for those programmes; the statement is not extended to other degrees.

faq.question: How should I interpret the fee information?
faq.answer: Request the current itemised schedule for the exact programme and stream. Reported programme fees are indicative secondary full-course figures with unitemised components. Confirm all compulsory charges, accommodation and personal costs separately.

faq.question: How do I apply?
faq.answer: Use the college’s notified online admission portal. Complete the application and required payments, then follow any selection information sent by SMS, email or the college website. Present original records when requested.

faq.question: Are teaching language and accommodation confirmed?
faq.answer: Confirm the exact programme’s teaching language directly. Hostel facilities are described in the prospectus, but availability, charges, mess arrangements and individual dietary requirements need a separate check before making travel plans.
